notes.title: Demo Update - 0.3.58 - STEAM NEXT Update
notes.notes:
During Steam Next we try to update Tricky Tracks regularly and as fast as possible.
These updates will be focus on fast hotfixes and, if necessary, bug-fixes. More content will then follow with the upcoming Early-Access release. 🥳

If you are interested in our development: Visit our live-dev streams: https://www.twitch.tv/tricky_tracks
We will stream every day during Steam Next!

notes.title: Demo Update - 0.3.49
notes.notes:
➕ Added: Smoke particle effect and funny sounds on team switch
 ➕ Added: Remote client-transforms are now interpolated to reduce stuttering. This may lead to small inconsistencies between the actual foots of the characters and the footprints. However, having a smoother gaming experience is a big plus. We would love to hear your feedback on this.
 ➕ Added: Short count down before the round actually starts. This prevents problems due to slow network calls that still need some time before round starts
 ➕ Added: Feedback Window. We would love to hear from you 💛




 ⭐ Improved: Net-Code for spawning and late join. Should be more robust now
 ⭐ Improved: "Quick Play" is now the first option when you click on "Play" in the main menu. This makes joining/creating session a bit more intuitive
 ⭐ Improved: Relocated region-switch in main menu since this option had nothing to do with creating a new session, we removed it into it's own panel




 🔧 FIXED: Late-Join camera bug
 🔧 FIXED: Finally the "How To Play" button in the ingame-menu works *yeey*
 🔧 FIXED: Seekers are properly listed again in the Session-Info panel
 🔧 FIXED: Several minor bugs

notes.title: Demo Update - 0.3.37
notes.notes:
➕ Added: Late-Join (in Preview) You are now able to join a session after it has started! Currently the default behavior is "Allowed - Instant Join". This means any late joiner will automatically join and can play right away. This feature will be improved in future updates
 ➕ Added: Ping-To-Discord in staging scene. This can help you to find players. The game pings the "Looking For Players" group on our official Tricky Tracks Discord. Please note that this feature has a cool-down in order to prevent spam.
 ➕ Added: Steam-Invite functionality in Staging scene *yeey*
 ➕ Added: In Spectator-Mode (after a RUNNER got caught) you now can navigate with the mouse buttons
 ➕ Added: Favorite Runner/Seeker Avatars to profile
 ➕ Added: Heroes now make a cool Hero-Landing on spawn



 ⭐ Improved: Lighting/Fog on Old London Map
 ⭐ Improved: New Icon in Staging for not-ready players
 ⭐ Improved: Overhauled the Round-End screen. All information now on one page + some bug fixes



 🔧 FIXED: Lots of bugs
 🔧 FIXED: Late-Join hotfix
